verdict.rationale: Outlook's own documented Inbox rules automatically handle incoming messages, for example by forwarding specific mail, so it directly delivers event-triggered rules for one event type. The pack only mentions this briefly and shows no other trigger types; change notifications are a developer alert mechanism, not user-defined rules. Missing for 10: rule triggers beyond incoming mail (e.g. calendar or other events), documented condition and action breadth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
